text: Some advice for you, [VAR 0100(0000)].\nThe Gym Challenge has a set order you’ll need\r\nto follow.[VAR 0114(000E)]

So that means your next stop should be in
Hulbury to meet Nessa. Hulbury’s just beyond
Route 5.\c
Or since you’ve got the Grass Badge, you could
head to the Wild Area.\c
It’s a bit tricky to catch Pokémon that are a
higher level than the Pokémon on your team, but
they make powerful allies if you succeed![VAR 0114(000E)]
